reason: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:222-228, useAllAlertRuleAbilities now only calls useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes `const isFederated = false` (line 245) instead of the removed `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. So immutableRule (line 250) is no longer true for federated Mimir groups, and useIsRuleEditable has no federated check to make up for it, which re-enables Update/Delete (and Pause/Restore wherever the rule counts as Grafana-managed).
